headline: TechnipFMC Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Rise Y/Y
summary: FTI tops Q2 earnings and revenue estimates as Subsea strength lifts margins and sales, while reaffirming full-year 2026 guidance and shareholder returns.

headline: The North American Midstream Universe In A Chart
summary: At the end of 2025, U.S. C-Corps were the largest portion of the North American midstream market cap at 42%. U.S. C-Corps were followed by MLPs at 32% and Canadian C-Corps at 26%.

headline: ProPetro Q2 Loss Wider Than Expected, Revenues Beat Estimates
summary: PUMP expects 2026 capital expenditures of $525-$595 million, with Completions spending projected at $125-$145 million and PROPWR spending expected to be $400-$450 million.
